contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE ; D/ D N VALEN S P F AVG

Copper alloy Nummus of Valens (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads: SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE. Reverse: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Mint is Arles, AD 367-375. LRBC P.56, Nos 528/532. Obverse legend reads: D N VALEN S P F AVG. Obverse: Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis: 6 o'clock
